name: mixer-runtime-identity-v1
status: implemented input descriptor; distribution, actual signed build embedding and complete graph capture pending
hash: SHA-256 of UTF-8 domain with final single NUL byte followed by restricted deterministic CBOR descriptor
canonicalization: RFC8949 restricted data model reused from release-v1: unsigned integers, booleans, text, arrays and maps with encoded keys lexicographically sorted; preferred shortest integers/lengths; no null/floats/tags/indefinite lengths. Hash covers the entire descriptor.

input.format: strict JSON; closed field sets at every object; every listed field mandatory
input.duplicateKeys: reject including equivalent escaped key spellings
input.numbers: unsigned base10 integer tokens only; uint64 range; no decimal/exponent/negative/bool coercion
input.strings: Identifiers ASCII [A-Za-z0-9_.-], 1..128 bytes; labels printable ASCII1..256 without boundary spaces; startup export exact UTF-8 1..4096 bytes with no U+0000..001F/U+007F; no Unicode normalization
input.digests: 64 lowercase hex SHA256 of named immutable build input bytes; empty sets hash their explicit serialized representation, never omit a digest

capabilities.protocol: nonempty capabilities require protocol2; no guest import approval implied

platforms.ios: arm64 device; arm64/x86_64 simulator; minimum major>=17 and canonical 2 or 3 numeric dotted components; exact ARCH-apple-iosMINIMUM[-simulator] target
platforms.android: arm64/x86_64 device or simulator; canonical unsigned API>=28; target aarch64 or x86_64-unknown-linux-androidAPI

authority.trustedInput: Compiled native/build configuration only; release metadata cannot choose the descriptor, fingerprint, installed grants or ceilings
authority.proof: Hash equality proves equal descriptors, not accurate or complete build inventory or trusted provenance
authority.factory: InstalledRuntime scope, versions, capability schema hashes, state and resource ceilings derive from the same validated descriptor
authority.embedding: Build pipeline must capture complete resolved graph and actual input files, then embed descriptor+fingerprint in native binary; signed provenance binds final binary hash to descriptor
authority.circularity: Native fallback, engine library and link input identities refer to pre-embedding inputs. Do not include final identity-bearing binary hash as an input to itself.
authority.compatibility: Exact fingerprint equality only; no ranges, automatic platform fallback or admission of unsupported VM imports
authority.grants: Native configuration/grants/permissions/trust-root files are hashed. This descriptor does not itself authorize network/storage access or bind supplied runtime objects to those file bytes.

limitations: No completed artifact attestation, isolated signed build, store publication, production native embedding or physical qualification
Input graph completeness and cryptographic trust root capture require separate build pipeline review
Current activation still rejects nonempty capabilities until guest imports are implemented
The existing string-based trusted installed policy API remains available for prior consumers; descriptor adoption is explicit
